name: zmodel_material_invalidate_images_if_eligible
description: zModel_Material::InvalidateImagesIfEligible invalidates the material's current texture directory entry and all cycle frame entries when the material has both flag bits 8 and 9 set.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage focuses on the material and cycle-frame invalidation behavior used by zDi and zClass callers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x480f80 validates null-material return, the combined flags 0x0300 eligibility test, invalidation of currentTextureDirectoryEntry, null-cycle return, and frameTable iteration by frameCount.
The native smoke verifies an eligible material invalidates both its current texture entry and its cycle frame entry.
